# External Terms

These short explanations translate formal external ontology terms that appear in GMEOW documentation. They are adoption aids, not replacements for the upstream definitions.

## [gUFO](ontologies.md#target-gufo)

| Term | Plain-language role | Formal IRI | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| <span id="gufo-abstractindividualtype"></span>[`gufo:AbstractIndividualType`](terms.md#gufo-abstractindividualtype) | abstract-individual value type | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividualType> | A type whose instances are abstract values rather than concrete objects, events, or relators. In GMEOW docs this usually means an open value vocabulary such as statuses, kinds, scales, or controlled values. |
| <span id="gufo-category"></span>[`gufo:Category`](terms.md#gufo-category) | cross-kind classification | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Category> | A broad classifier that can apply across multiple identity-bearing kinds. |
| <span id="gufo-disposition"></span>[`gufo:Disposition`](terms.md#gufo-disposition) | capacity or tendency | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Disposition> | An intrinsic feature that may manifest under conditions, such as a hazard as a bearer-specific disposition toward harm. |
| <span id="gufo-event"></span>[`gufo:Event`](terms.md#gufo-event) | event occurrence | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Event> | A concrete happening in time. |
| <span id="gufo-eventtype"></span>[`gufo:EventType`](terms.md#gufo-eventtype) | event type | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#EventType> | A classifier for happenings, processes, executions, observations, or other temporal occurrences. |
| <span id="gufo-functionalcomplex"></span>[`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex) | object-like whole | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#FunctionalComplex> | A concrete object or system treated as a functional whole, such as a person, organization, device, or software system. |
| <span id="gufo-intrinsicaspect"></span>[`gufo:IntrinsicAspect`](terms.md#gufo-intrinsicaspect) | dependent feature | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#IntrinsicAspect> | A feature that inheres in a bearer and cannot exist independently from that bearer. |
| <span id="gufo-intrinsicmode"></span>[`gufo:IntrinsicMode`](terms.md#gufo-intrinsicmode) | intrinsic dependent feature | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#IntrinsicMode> | A bearer-specific internal feature that is not primarily a measured quality value. In GMEOW this explains things like emotions, desires, and intentions as features of an agent rather than standalone objects. |
| <span id="gufo-kind"></span>[`gufo:Kind`](terms.md#gufo-kind) | identity-providing type | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Kind> | A main sort of thing whose instances share an identity principle, such as Person, Document, Event, or Procedure. |
| <span id="gufo-mixin"></span>[`gufo:Mixin`](terms.md#gufo-mixin) | shared classifier | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Mixin> | A reusable classifier that can cut across multiple kinds without providing identity by itself. |
| <span id="gufo-object"></span>[`gufo:Object`](terms.md#gufo-object) | concrete object | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Object> | A concrete endurant object. |
| <span id="gufo-phase"></span>[`gufo:Phase`](terms.md#gufo-phase) | temporary state-like specialization | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Phase> | A phase an instance can enter or leave while keeping the same identity. |
| <span id="gufo-phasemixin"></span>[`gufo:PhaseMixin`](terms.md#gufo-phasemixin) | temporary cross-kind classifier | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#PhaseMixin> | A reusable phase-style classifier that can apply across multiple kinds. |
| <span id="gufo-quality"></span>[`gufo:Quality`](terms.md#gufo-quality) | measurable intrinsic quality | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Quality> | A measurable intrinsic aspect whose value lies in a value space. |
| <span id="gufo-qualityvalue"></span>[`gufo:QualityValue`](terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue) | quality value | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#QualityValue> | A value in a quality or classification space. In GMEOW this often backs open enumerations without freezing them as closed OWL enums. |
| <span id="gufo-relator"></span>[`gufo:Relator`](terms.md#gufo-relator) | relationship object | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Relator> | A reified relationship that connects participants and can carry its own metadata, roles, provenance, and temporal scope. |
| <span id="gufo-role"></span>[`gufo:Role`](terms.md#gufo-role) | context-dependent specialization | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Role> | A role an instance plays in some context without changing its underlying identity. |
| <span id="gufo-rolemixin"></span>[`gufo:RoleMixin`](terms.md#gufo-rolemixin) | context-dependent cross-kind role | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#RoleMixin> | A reusable role classifier that can apply to instances of multiple kinds. |
| <span id="gufo-situationtype"></span>[`gufo:SituationType`](terms.md#gufo-situationtype) | situation type | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#SituationType> | A classifier for states of affairs rather than concrete objects or events. |
| <span id="gufo-subkind"></span>[`gufo:SubKind`](terms.md#gufo-subkind) | identity-preserving subtype | <http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#SubKind> | A narrower type under a Kind that inherits identity from that Kind. |
